ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Fraud Cases
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial trails of recent fraud cases in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future scandal.
questions: What are the common financial patterns among recent fraud cases in Minnesota?
How can the state prevent future instances of fraud?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial trails of recent fraud cases, we may be able to identify patterns and vulnerabilities that can be addressed to prevent future instances of fraud.
